# Replacements 0.3.4
A new, more graphic app icon: two short character strokes become three word strokes through a curved blue arrow. Original vector artwork on a clean white Mac icon tile.
The 259-template library, including 200 static emoticons, and all existing shortcut features are retained.
Universal Apple Silicon/Intel app, Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. macOS 15 or later. Free and open source.
